name: LX-80
description: The LX-80 was an anti-infantry missile launcher emplacement. Developed by Merr-Sonn Munitions, the launcher used missiles designed for the company's PLX series of portable missile launchers. The LX-80 launcher contained eighty missiles in as many missile tubes, and an automatic loader could reload those tubes with the launcher's reserve of missiles when the first payload was expended.
